proposals.evidence: DEDR1655 explicitly gives Malayalam kuṭi house/family/wife. Kadar kuḍi wife is a comparative neighbouring-lect continuation of that household/wife noun, preserving source stop voicing; the Sanskrit hut comparisons do not establish an immediate loan for this particular Kadar response. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These simple tampi/tambi survey responses continue the specific younger-brother kinship noun, retaining source intervocalic voicing and final vowels. The correct article is3085, not3485 (enclosure). This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These simple and ordinary participial/nominal survey forms retain that drink stem and documented inflectional bases; source vowel/voicing and final morphology are preserved. Possible causative kuḍisu forms and opaque auxiliaries are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
